summary: LBM with standard half-way bounce-back cannot achieve <3% C_f accuracy due to first-order near-wall resolution limitation
root_cause: Standard half-way bounce-back BC has first-order accuracy near wall; first fluid node at y=0.5 overpredicts velocity by ~27%
recommendations: Implement interpolated bounce-back for second-order accuracy
Or use wall models/wall functions for high-Re flows
Or use grid stretching with finer resolution near wall
Current implementation suitable for qualitative analysis only
